Vytvoří zařízení routeru se souhrny a se: Creates a router device with summaries and a list of clients. Client entities are optional. WOL is only sent manually. We recommend HTTPS and certificate verification.
Obvykle 8001 pro HTTPS nebo 8000 pro HTT: Usually 8001 for HTTPS or 8000 for HTTP.
Vypnutí je výslovná volba pro nedůvěryho: Disable is an explicit option for an untrusted local certificate.
Enter the current data of the same router. Client identities will be preserved.
Změnit připojení ke stejnému routeru: Change the connection to the same router
Použijte při změně IP nebo přihlašovacíc: Use when changing IP or login details. The identity of the configuration will remain the same.
Nelze se připojit k SRM. Zkontrolujte ad: Unable to connect to SRM. Check the address, port and availability of the router.
Zadejte pouze IP adresu nebo hostname, b: Enter only IP address or hostname, without protocol, port and path.
Přihlášení do SRM selhalo. Ověřte údaje: Login to SRM failed. Verify account details and permissions.
Účet nemá oprávnění číst klienty routeru: The account does not have permission to read router clients.
Certifikát nelze ověřit. Ověřte hostname: The certificate cannot be verified. Verify the hostname and certificate; only consciously turn off authentication.
SRM vyžaduje další faktor přihlášení. Te: SRM requires an additional login factor. This flow is not yet supported by the integration. Don't turn off 2FA automatically.
Router nepodporuje požadované klientské: The router does not support the required client API v5.
Klientské API vrací jinou strukturu. Spu: The client API returns a different structure. Run tools/probe.py local diagnostics as instructed. DevTools are not needed.
Tato verze podporuje jeden router. Pro z: This version supports one router. To change the address, use Reconfigure with an existing integration.
The connection settings have been changed.
Interval klientů lze nastavit od 5 sekun: The client interval can be set from 5 seconds (default 30 s). The table of all clients remains with the router. The selected client entities and trackers are in the Integrated Clients device under this integration.
Povolit vybrané entity připojení: Allow the selected entities to connect
Klienti se samostatnou entitou připojení: Clients with a separate connection entity
Odstranit nevybrané klientské entity tét: Remove unselected client entities of this integration
Ověřená vstupní jednotka rychlostí route: Verified input unit at router speed
Výběr zapne tracker v zařízení Integrova: The selection turns on the tracker in the Integrated Clients device. An empty selection means no trackers.
5 až 3600 sekund. Výchozí hodnota 30. Pě: 5 to 3600 seconds. Default value is 30. Five seconds means 12 queries per minute; these are not immediate events.
Prázdný výběr nevytvoří žádné klientské: An empty selection will not create any client entities. The list of all clients will remain with the router.
Uklidí také entity automaticky vytvořené: It will also clean up entities automatically created by version 0.1.0. Removes unselected entities and their settings from the HA registry; their automation may need to be modified. It will not remove the router or other integrations.
Nastavte až po ověření proti SRM. Výstup: Set only after validating against SRM. The table output will always be KB/s (1000 B/s). Unverified speeds will remain blank.
Download a upload se vztahují ke kliento: Download and upload refer to the client. Until the direction is verified, the original RX/TX are only in details.
RAM – využití bez cache a bufferů: RAM - use without cache and buffers
Využití swapu podle SRM: Use of swap according to SRM
100 × (total_real − avail_real − buffer: 100 × (total_real − avail_real − buffer − cached) / total_real. Cache and buffers are not counted as occupied by applications. The result may differ from SRM rounding.
DL = download, UL = upload klienta. KB/s: DL = download, UL = client upload. KB/s = 1000 Bps. The signal is the original value without the verified unit.
DL/UL čeká na ověření vstupní jednotky a: DL/UL pending verification of input unit and direction in integration options. The original RX/TX can be found in the client details. The signal has no verified unit.
Hledat název, IP nebo MAC: Search by name, IP or MAC
Klient již není v aktuálním seznamu. Zob: The client is no longer in the current list. The displayed data is the last known.
The client is not in the router's current response.
Měření spuštěno na 90 sekund, interval {: Measurement started for 90 seconds, interval {p0} s. Then download integration diagnostics. Start time: {p1}.
Měření zastaveno. Vzorky zůstávají v dia: Measurement stopped. The samples remain in diagnostics until the integration is restarted.
Nastavení se nepodařilo uložit. Změňte v: Failed to save settings. Change the option again after the connection is restored.
Načtení selhalo; zobrazené podrobnosti m: Load failed; the details shown may be out of date.
Názvy podle SRM; chybějící název nenahra: Names according to SRM; we do not replace the missing name with an estimate.
Offline – údaje o síti mohou být posledn: Offline - network data may be last known.
Ostatní kategorie zatížení hlášené route: Other load categories reported by the router.
Paket odeslán z HA do místní sítě. Probu: Packet sent from HA to local network. Wakeup must be supported and enabled by the target device; sending is not a wake-up confirmation.
Router není dostupný. Zobrazené údaje mo: The router is not available. The displayed data may be out of date.
Router v klientské odpovědi neposkytuje: The router does not provide traffic measurements for this cable client in the client response.
Skrytí klienta se nepodařilo uložit. Zku: Failed to save client hide. Please try again.
Skrytí pouze v tabulce integrace; tracke: Hide only in integration table; neither the tracker nor the router changes.
Souhrny klientů a nezměněný stav WAN dod: Client summaries and unchanged WAN status delivered by SRM.
Součet uživatelského, systémového a osta: Sum of user, system and other CPU usage in percentage.
Spojení není dostupné; údaje mohou být z: The connection is not available; data may be out of date.
Spojení s routerem selhalo; údaje mohou: The connection to the router failed; data may be out of date.
Systémové údaje se načítají každých 5 mi: System data is loaded every 5 minutes; the client interval is separate.
Tabulka se obnovuje každých {p0} sekund: The table is refreshed every {p0} seconds from the last integration data.
Tabulku se nepodařilo načíst. Ověřte při: Failed to load table. Verify connecting to HA and loading the integration. The displayed data may be out of date.
Memory usage in percent reported by SRM. Reserved memory is not based on percentages.
WOL se nepodařilo odeslat. Ověřte oprávn: WOL failed to send. Verify administrator privileges and HA network.
Průběh od spuštění integrace, nejvýše 24: Progress since the start of the integration, maximum 24 hours. Refresh after 5 minutes.
Porty – rychlost spojení dle SRM (nikoli: Ports - connection speed according to SRM (not data transfer)
Propojení mezi uzly SRM v této odpovědi: The link between the SRM nodes does not differentiate in this response.
